strategy_path.description: Path to the written Deployment_Strategy.md file.

migration_command_valid.description: True when staging and production both use 'prisma migrate deploy' — never 'prisma db push'.

migration_command_violations.description: Environments where prisma db push was incorrectly specified. Must be empty.

cron_jobs_configured.description: Cron jobs configured in vercel.json with guardCron() requirement documented.

cron_jobs_missing_guard.description: Cron job paths missing guardCron() documentation. Must be empty.

rollback_plan_present.description: Whether the strategy includes an actionable rollback plan for both application and database.

rollback_rto_minutes.description: Recovery Time Objective for application rollback (Vercel Instant Rollback).

smoke_tests_defined.description: True when at minimum /api/health, auth flow, 1 read, and 1 write smoke test are defined.

env_vars_documented.description: True when all required env vars are listed per environment and lib/env.ts validation confirmed.

gate_6_prerequisites_met.description: True when rollback plan present, migration command valid, and smoke tests defined — Gate 6 pre-requisites satisfied from architecture side.
